rule_name: M5-Bus power pins fixed, GPIO maps differ by host
detail: Official: M5-Bus 2x15P@2.54mm has fixed power/GND positions; other pins vary by controller. Programs and DIP switches must follow the actual host pin map. Do not treat stacking as electrically identical across generations.

rule_name: First-gen Core vs Core2 vs CoreS3 vs Tab5 UART/SPI GPIO numbers
detail: Examples from fetched pages: first-gen PORT.C UART G17/G16; Core2 PORT.C G14/G13 and UART2 G13/G14; CoreS3 PORT.C G17/G18; Tab5 PORT.A only on-body (G53/G54) and M5-Bus PC_RX/TX G7/G6. SPI MOSI also moves (Core/Core2 G23 vs CoreS3 G37 vs Tab5 G18).

rule_name: GPS v2 DIP remap is required per host
detail: Official pin-change guide gives host columns for TXD/RXD/PPS. Example defaults: Core TX G17 RX G16; Core2 TX G14 RX G13; CoreS3 TX G17 RX G18. Wrong DIP is a pin conflict risk, not proof the module is 'incompatible' with that host.

rule_name: Fire PSRAM occupies GPIO16/17
side_b: Any module/Unit using G16/G17 (including first-gen PORT.C UART)
detail: Official Fire v2.7: GPIO 16/17 connected to PSRAM by default; avoid conflicts when connecting or stacking other modules. This is a documented pin reservation, not a blanket module ban.

rule_name: Core2 cannot stack generic Base series
detail: Official Core2 warning: built-in vibration motor interferes structurally with Base series bases; do not stack to prevent damage. Recommended alternative when stacking modules: remove Core2 battery bottom; use M5GO Bottom2 to keep IMU/mic/battery.

rule_name: M5GO Bottom2 is Core2-specific
detail: Official: designed specifically for / compatible with the Core2 series. Pin map uses Core2 numbers (SK6812 G25, mic G34/G0, IMU G21/G22, PORT.B/C). Not documented as a first-gen Fire/Basic bottom replacement.

rule_name: CoreS3 magnetometer interference
detail: Official: magnets may interfere with BMM150 resulting in abnormal readings; remove magnets / avoid strong fields when used with magnetic M5 controllers. This is a sensing-quality issue, not a mechanical insertion ban.

rule_name: CoreMP135 is Linux/STM32 not ESP32
detail: Official M5-Bus uses STM32 pin names and Linux device nodes. Bus 5V output is disabled by default and must be enabled (BUS_OUT_EN) before I2C scan or module init. Do not call untested modules incompatible; software/power bring-up differs.

rule_name: Tab5 is ESP32-P4 + C6, unique M5-Bus map
side_b: Module series via rear M5-Bus; Units via single PORT.A
detail: Official: rear M5-Bus expands Module series; one HY2.0-4P PORT.A (G53/G54). Wireless is companion ESP32-C6, not the application host. DIP/module code written for Core/Core2/CoreS3 GPIO numbers will be wrong until remapped.

rule_name: Grove ports are typed (A I2C / B GPIO-ADC / C UART)
detail: Official start page: HY2.0-4P is a modular interface, but Core pin tables explicitly type PORT.A as I2C, PORT.B as DAC/ADC or GPIO, PORT.C as UART (numbers change by generation). Unit Ultrasonic-I2C vs Ultrasonic-IO is an official split of the same sensor family by protocol. Not every Unit works on every Grove socket.

rule_name: I2C address collisions and PaHub
side_b: Multiple I2C Units/HATs/panels sharing an address
detail: Official I2C address index exists. PaHub default 0x70 (range 0x70-0x77) isolates channels; its own address may need changing if another device uses 0x70. Faces Keyboard3 and Gamepad3 both document I2C 0x08.

rule_name: Classic Stick HAT I2C map
side_b: I2C HATs such as Hat DAC2, Mini JoyC, PowerC
detail: Multiple official Hat pages map StickC SDA=G0 SCL=G26 5V GND and list StickC / PLUS / PLUS2. Plus2 is officially described as HAT and Unit compatible, but its mic CLK also uses G0 — coexistence risk, not an official incompatibility statement.

rule_name: Hat SPK2 is I2S and 3V3-powered
side_a: Stick series with compatible HAT + I2S
detail: Official: I2S input, powered from host 3V3 pin, not an I2C G0/G26 device. Distinct from classic PAM8303 Speaker Hat.

rule_name: StickS3 uses Hat2-Bus and has named structural bans
side_b: Hat Mini JoyC U156, Mini EncoderC U157, Hat 18650C U080
detail: Official StickS3 compatibility note: structurally incompatible with those three SKUs. StickS3 expansion is Hat2-Bus 2.54-16P, not the classic documented 8-pin G0/G26 map. Other classic HAT fitment is 未知 — do not assume drop-in compatibility or a total ban.

rule_name: Chain is UART daisy-chain with ordered IDs
side_a: Chain DualKey or Atom+Atomic ToChain Base
detail: Official: master + nodes; nodes typically STM32G031; IN/OUT HY2.0-4P; UART 115200; IDs assigned from 1 outward; DualKey has two independent buses; packets hop by decrementing ID; heartbeat and enumeration; hot-plug supported. Connector looks like Grove but protocol is not I2C Unit.

rule_name: Atomic ToChain pin defaults differ by Atom generation
detail: Official default HY2.0 map: AtomS3/S3R G5/G6; classic Atom G22/G19. Solder pads allow remap.

rule_name: Faces panels need Faces Bottom + Core host
detail: Official Bottom3: compatible with Faces function panels Gen1/Gen3 and Core series hosts; LED IO switch for different hosts; panel bus 2.54-22P. Keyboard3/Gamepad3 are STM32 I2C peripherals (0x08), not hosts.

rule_name: Auxiliary MCU is not an independent host
detail: Official Chain tutorial: nodes use STM32G031 as core controller of the node, while the master is DualKey or Atom+ToChain. Faces Keyboard3/Gamepad3 integrate STM32 and talk I2C to a host. Unit Thermal2 has ESP32-PICO-D4 but communicates to a host via I2C 0x33; official text also allows independent use — still sold as a Unit. Unit CardKB2 has ESP32-C61 but default mode is I2C Unit.

rule_name: 8Servos2 I2C vs Chain are different SKUs
detail: Official products listing and history distinguish Unit 8Servos2-I2C U222 and Unit 8Servos2-Chain U223, both STM32G031 but different buses.

rule_name: Interactive Stack Compatibility tool exists but was not a static table
detail: Official page https://docs.m5stack.com/en/compatible is an interactive stacked-bus viewer ('choose one host, multiple modules, and one base'). This research fetched the page shell but not every interactive combination. Unchecked combos remain 未知, not incompatible.
